_doc: Copy to <workspace>/tools/audit.config.json and adjust. Keys not listed fall back to audit.py defaults.
_doc_entry: First existing entry file wins; non-code projects may use WORKSPACE.md or BRIEF.md.
_doc_docs: Document roots; if none exist, the workspace is scanned shallowly (depth <= 2).
_doc_state: State pointer (JSON, or key-value YAML). May also live at the root.
_doc_archive: Archive directories; live documents must never route to them.
_doc_limits: Line limits; index/inventory/pitfalls are relaxed. Exempt categories must be listed here.
_doc_markers: Confidence vocabulary: one set only. Variants are reported as FAIL.
_doc_dup: Cross-file sentence similarity (3-gram Jaccard); higher is less sensitive.
_doc_budget: Cold-start budget: entry + state + top index, estimated tokens.
_doc_stale: derived_at older than this many days is a WARN; state_lag_hours reconciles STATE against logs.
_doc_floor: P05 floor: non-index pages shorter than this are flagged (anti-fragmentation).
_doc_evidence: P22: maximum evidence citations to report.
_doc_index_cap: Suffix index cap; stop building beyond this (large-repo protection).
_doc_scope: P04 scan scope: entry and top index.
_doc_tier: Enable by scale: L0=6 (one-off) / L1=12 (sustained solo, recommended) / L2=22 (teams, long-lived).
_doc_alt: Extra roots used to resolve inline paths and evidence citations relative to another project root.
